/root/work/sign-product/send-venv/bin/python - <<'EOF'
import json, os
calls=[]
for line in open('counterparty-c2a-gate3-r27.jsonl'):
    try: d=json.loads(line)
    except: continue
    if not isinstance(d,dict): continue
    m=d.get('message')
    if not isinstance(m,dict): continue
    c=m.get('content')
    if isinstance(c,list):
        for b in c:
            if isinstance(b,dict) and b.get('type')=='tool_use': calls.append(b)
for i in (58, 61, 62): print('=====', i); print(calls[i]['input']['command'])
print(sorted(os.listdir('/root/worktrees/send-c1b/docs/implementation/c2a-r28')))
EOF
